# ADR-3211: AWS encryption: SSE-S3 demotion for regulated bucket 3

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Normative language in the Decision section follows RFC 2119 (Bradner, S., "Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels", BCP 14, March 1997).

Customer-controlled keys is expected to be is expected to.

## Decision

Regulated buckets MUST NOT allow an SSE-S3 demotion for regulated bucket 3 (AWS-encryption-3).

## Consequences

SSE-KMS with CMKs is the baseline.
